title: Around You under the map is a Frequency kit board: ticker, tally tiles that are the tabs, one panel, three doors

source.ref: Daniel's list of 30 design changes, 2026-10-19, item 4 (audited partial 2026-10-20 01:32Z)

detail: Under Frequency the area below the map is rebuilt in members kit classes. A glass Dispatch ticker leads; four large tally tiles (events, circles, members, Dispatches this week) are also the tabs via ?tab=, the chosen tile lights the pastel pill, and one panel shows that list (four gatherings with date chips and Today/Tomorrow tags, forming circles, new faces, or the latest eight Dispatches with the compose control). Three doors close the page. The DAWN layout is unchanged. No read changed: event, circle and member filters are the same ones page.test.ts pins.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/nearby/page.tsx','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('components/nearby/around-you-board.tsx','utf8');if(!p.includes('<AroundYouBoard'))bad.push('page stopped rendering the board under Frequency');if(!b.includes('?tab=${t}'))bad.push('tally tiles stopped being the tabs');for(const t of ['events','circles','people','dispatches'])if(!b.includes(\"'\"+t+\"'\"))bad.push('missing tab '+t);if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1073: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the page stops using the board or the tiles stop being tabs. Behavior is app/(main)/nearby/page.test.ts and components/nearby/around-you-board.test.ts.
